lines.speaker: Harry Potter
lines.text: This vial is proof, Professor. The real thief is still inside the Room of Requirement, brewing Polyjuice right now. I found this bottle by the tapestry while Filch chased us down the hall.
lines.expression: hands the vial to McGonagall without breaking stride, eyes fixed ahead

lines.speaker: Professor McGonagall
lines.text: You expect me to believe a student stumbled onto a serious breach while violating curfew? You have earned detention every Saturday until June. We will discuss your sources at length then.
lines.expression: accepts the vial, lips thinning, gaze boring into Harry's face
